title: Software Engineering Intern, Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Computer Science or related technical field.
qualification: Proficiency in one or more general-purpose programming languages including Java, C++, Python, or Go.
description: Work on core software products, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and build scalable system infrastructure.

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
eligibility: Graduate students, young professionals, and artists from eligible participating countries.
qualification: Bachelor's degree or equivalent, strong academic record, and English language proficiency.
description: Enables international graduate students and young professionals to study and conduct research in universities across the United States.

title: Junior Frontend Engineer
eligibility: Open to early-career software developers worldwide with relevant project experience.
qualification: Experience with JavaScript, Vue.js or React, Git, HTML/CSS, and modern web application development.
description: Contribute to GitLab's open-source web application interface, fix bugs, and collaborate in an all-remote global team.

title: Associate Data Scientist
eligibility: Recent graduates or professionals with 0-2 years of relevant data science experience.
qualification: Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or Quantitative Field. Knowledge of Python, SQL, and ML models.
description: Apply machine learning algorithms, analyze enterprise-scale datasets, and deliver insights for cloud platform services.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2025
eligibility: Students aged 16+ currently enrolled in high school or higher education institutions.
qualification: Team of 1-4 students building an innovative technology solution leveraging AI and Microsoft Azure.
description: A premier global technology competition giving students the opportunity to build innovative solutions that address societal challenges.

title: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide, no prior programming or computer science experience required.
description: An entry-level course teaching fundamental algorithms, problem-solving techniques, and languages including C, Python, SQL, and JavaScript.
